mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 3.5% triggers a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns do not decline significantly (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (business investment) signals robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window when both proxies rise concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in INDPRO (supply) indicates stronger production capacity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during INDPRO expansion phases.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in FEDFUNDS above 2% signals contractionary policy, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS crosses above 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both PAYEMS (payrolls) and UNRATE (unemployment) indicates contradictory labor market signals, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both proxies rise concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained crossing of INDPRO above 110 signals accelerated production growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during INDPRO expansion phases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a rise in FEDFUNDS above 1.5% signals preemptive tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2% in 1 month during late-cycle expansion
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during late-cycle expansion when FEDFUNDS crosses above 1.5%.
